notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Barbarian Outcast.
A player controls no Swamps.
description:
If needed, give control of Barbarian Outcast to an opponent who controls no Swamps.
When Barbarian Outcast's controller controls no Swamps, Barbarian Outcast triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Barbarian Outcast cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Barbarian Outcast triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.
